method: Serialized Chromium SwiftShader SOFTWARE tests. Wind: one isolated spreading tree, 640x480 DPR1, fixed pose/time, twelve warm alternating GPU finish/readback samples per compile mode. CPU field alone, excludes conversion/upload. Solar: actual forest 480x320 DPR1, eight alternating forced invalidate(false) and held-map GPU finish/readback renders per profile/version; forced updates retain fixed spatial selection. Counts are source diagnostics, no physical VRAM or phone FPS.
